title: Vancouver City Tour: Stanley Park, Granville Island, and Capilano
includes: Professional Tour guide (Bilingual Chinese-English tour guide)
Tour commentary may be provided by a live guide and/or audio guiding system.
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb:
Discover Vancouver’s top highlights on this full-day city tour, combining urban culture and natural scenery.

Visit iconic neighborhoods like Gastown and Chinatown, then explore Stanley Park with scenic coastal views and famous totem poles. Continue to Granville Island, where you can browse local shops and enjoy the public market at your own pace.

Unlike typical city tours with quick stops, this experience allows more time at key locations, so you can walk around, take photos, and fully enjoy each destination.
